name: forward_generated_artifact
description: Plan A smoke graph, run by hand: the agent generates an image with image_generation, then forwards the resulting document via http_request multipart using $attachment:<document_id>. Needs OPENAI_API_KEY. The deterministic coverage of that chain lives in tests/attachment_uniform_resolution_test.rs, which drives HttpNode directly and does NOT load this file.

test_payload.prompt: Generá una imagen de un gato astronauta en la luna y subila al endpoint de la base de conocimiento.

config.system_message:
You are an upload agent. Workflow:
1. Call generate_image once to produce an image. The response contains images[0].document_id.
2. Call http_upload with body = { "file": "$attachment:<document_id>" } using the document_id from step 1.
Do not skip tools. Do not invent placeholders.

generate_image.name: generate_image
generate_image.description: Generate a brand-new image from a text prompt. Returns { images: [{ document_id, ... }] }. Pass the document_id to http_upload as '$attachment:<document_id>'.

prompt.description: Detailed text prompt describing the image to generate.

http_upload.name: http_upload
http_upload.description: Upload a generated artifact as multipart/form-data to the KB endpoint. The body must be {"file": "$attachment:<document_id>"} where <document_id> is the value returned by generate_image.

body.description: Must be { "file": "$attachment:<document_id>" } using the value from generate_image.
